# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/thedeadbolt/MineSophila/security/advisories/new).

Maintainers will acknowledge your report within a week. After preparing a fix, they will
publish an advisory and credit you unless you ask to remain anonymous.

## Supported versions

The project is pre-1.0. Maintainers provide fixes for the latest release of each package.
